result.edit: The failure occurs at cycle 12 where the output should be '01' (not_match) but is '00'. Tracing back, the state transitions from sf1 to sf2 to sf3 to sf4 incorrectly always go to sf1 regardless of data input. The fix makes sf4 transition to sf5 on data=1 (continuing the mismatch path) or sf1 on data=0 (starting a new group). This ensures proper output when the full group doesn't match the target sequence.
